text: 8am with Woodgrove done. Hyun-woo Park (Head of Infrastructure) plus Leila Ahmadi from their risk team. They're going ahead with the core banking hosting migration, 18 months. Hyun-woo promised to send the signed data processing addendum by Wed 13 May, and he'll free up two of his DBAs for the first 6 weeks. Kick-off pencilled for 1 Jun.
Leila wants our ISO 27001 certificate and the subprocessor list before kick-off
they also want weekly steering calls on Mondays for the whole migration
Contoso at 9:30 with Sipho Ndlovu, their new service delivery manager. First meeting since he took over. What should I cover to build trust fast?
he came from a telco, very metrics-driven apparently

Contoso: Sipho wants a monthly service review instead of quarterly, starting June. He's pushing for a 15-minute response SLA on P1s, we're on 30 today. Their helpdesk volume is about 2,300 tickets a month.
my take: 15 min on P1 is doable in business hours, not 24x7 without more staff
draft a reply to Sipho proposing 15 min P1 response in business hours and 30 min after hours, first monthly review on 4 Jun
make it warmer, he's new and I want him on side
Tailspin call: Camille Laurent (procurement) says the SOW redlines are agreed except the liability cap. They want 1.5x annual fees, we offered 1x. Our legal says we can go to 1.25x.
Camille also wants net 45 payment terms instead of net 30
draft an email to Camille offering 1.25x with data breaches capped separately, and net 45 is fine
Litware: Arash Tehrani (CTO) wants to extend the Azure landing zone work to their two subsidiaries. Rough size 8 weeks, 2 engineers. He needs a ballpark by Monday for his board pack.
ballpark at our blended $1,150/day, 2 engineers, 8 weeks? quick maths pls
he also hinted the board wants a fixed price, not T&M
draft a 3-line ballpark email to Arash I can send now, fixed price with a 10% contingency
Northwind at 1:30 with Valentina Greco (Head of Service). They're benchmarking our service desk against two other providers. Give me 3 points on where we're strongest
their CFO is Ivan Petrov, he signs off anything over $250k
Northwind: Valentina shared the benchmark. We're best on CSAT (4.4) but most expensive per ticket, $29 vs $24 and $25 for the other two. She has to justify the gap to Ivan by end of May.
she'd consider a 3-year term if we close half the gap
what levers do I have to cut cost per ticket without hurting CSAT? 4-5 ideas
draft a note to Valentina proposing a 3-year term at $26.50 per ticket plus a shift-left knowledge base project
Valentina already replied, she likes the knowledge base idea and wants a short business case she can take to Ivan
outline that business case for me, keep it tight
Hooli: Oskar Andersen (Engineering Manager) wants 3 extra SRE contractors for 6 months from 1 Jun for their observability rollout. Rate card $95/hr. Needs CVs by Tuesday.
he said the last vendor sent juniors and he won't take anyone with less than 5 years of Kubernetes
draft a quick note to our resourcing team asking for 3 senior SRE profiles, 5+ years Kubernetes, by Monday
prep: Initech at 4 with Mariana Costa (IT Director). They're unhappy about laptop delivery delays. What do I say about the supply problem without throwing the OEM under the bus?
it's the Q2 refresh batch, 120 units

Initech: Mariana is frustrated, the 120 laptops are 3 weeks late because of a GPU shortage at the OEM. She'll accept a staged delivery, 60 on 18 May and 60 on 1 Jun, if we lend them 20 loaners in the meantime.
we have 14 loaners in stock, need 6 more from the depot
Mariana also wants a delivery update every Friday until it's done
draft the email to Mariana confirming the staged delivery and 20 loaners from Monday
Camille replied, Tailspin accepts 1.25x with the breach carve-out. Contract goes to signature next week.
Oskar wants the CVs by Monday now, not Tuesday
Litware: Arash asked for the ballpark in GBP as well
Contoso: Sipho accepted the split SLA, first monthly review on 4 Jun confirmed
One thing before I sign off: on my first call this morning, what did the client promise to send us, and by when?

expect.should: Identifies Woodgrove and says Hyun-woo Park promised to send the signed data processing addendum by Wed 13 May
expect.should_not: A different client, document or deadline from the later calls (e.g. Hooli's CVs by Monday, Litware's ballpark, Initech's laptops on 18 May, Contoso's 4 Jun review), an invented answer, or a claim that there is no record of the call
